CITY OF LA VERNE
  SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  AGENDA

Terry Kistler, Chair  La Verne Community Center
Bette Donovan, Member  Classroom 1
Edward Padgett, Member  3680 D Street
Scott Snider, Member  La Verne, CA 91750
Jenny Jolly, Member  (909) 596-8776
George Borst, Member
Valarie Finlay, Member
Yvonne Duran, Staff Liaison
Armando Cisneros, Staff Liaison
Robyn Olsen, Staff Liaison

  Wednesday, October 15, 2025 – 10:00 a.m.
  La Verne Community Center Classroom 1

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
La Verne Community Center at (909) 596-8776 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Public comments will be allowed near the conclusion of the meeting.

  1. ROLL CALL – Terry Kistler, Bette Donovan, Edward Padgett, Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly,
  George Borst, Valarie Finlay

  2. PRESENTATIONS – None

  3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES – September 17, 2025

  4. DISCUSSION & ACTION ITEMS
  a. Senior Nutrition Program – Armando Cisneros
  b. Meals on Wheels Program – Armando Cisneros
  c. Bingo Report – George Borst
  d. Account Balance Update – Armando Cisneros
  e. Monthly Senior Program Fees – Armando Cisneros
  f. Mt. SAC Classes Update – Armando Cisneros
  g. Aging Next – Armando Cisneros
  h. Outstanding Older American – Armando Cisneros
  i. Facilities Report – Yvonne Duran
   j.  Upcoming Events – Robyn Olsen

  5. PUBLIC COMMENT
  Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject
  matter jurisdiction of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda
  items except as provided by law.

  6. STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION/INFORMATION

  7. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 a.m. on November 19, 2025 at the La Verne Community Center, 3680 D Street,
  La Verne CA 91750.

Posting Statement: On October 9, 2025 a true and correct copy of this Notice was posted on
the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at
www.laverneca.gov.
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, October 15, 2025

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, October 15, 2025.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, George Borst,
  Scott Snider.

  Members Absent: Jenny Jolly, Valarie Ortiz

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Parks & Recreation Specialist, Robyn
  Olsen, Parks & Recreation Specialist. Yvonne Duran, Parks & Recreation
  Director.

  It was moved by Bette Donovan and seconded by Edward Padgett to approve the
  minutes of Wednesday, September 17, 2025. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 560 meals were served to an average of 27 participants in
  September.

  Meals on Wheels: 504 meals were delivered to La Verne residents in the
  month of August. 524 meals were delivered to La Verne residents in the
  month of September.

4. Bingo Report: Bingo receipts totaled $7,658.00. Ending balance in the
  account through September was $30 after $7,658.00 in payouts and
  expenses. The number of players in attendance for the month of September:
  243.

5. Account Balance: $2,871.00.

6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid except Woodcarvers.
 7. MT. SAC Classes: Currently in Fall Session. Everything is going well.

8. Outstanding Older American: Applications were distributed and the final vote will be
  taken during the first meeting in January 2026.

9. Aging Next: Total number of La Verne Residents served for the month of
  September was 11. La Verne Residents served via Joslyn Center: 3. La Verne
  Residents served via AgingNext Office: 8.

  New Business

10. Facilities Report: Yvonne reported that there are some issues at Veterans Hall
  that are being taken care of. The leak in the Senior Craft Room is still there.
  Working on getting it patched or fixed. New roof might be installed at the
  aquatics center. Plumbing issues at the restrooms near Oak Mesa
  playground have been resolved.

11. Upcoming Events

  •  Friday, October 16th – Excursion: Oak Tree Mountain, 8:30AM-4:00PM.
  •  Thursday, October 30th – Halloween Themed Line Dancing Party, 10:00AM.
  •  Wednesday, November 5th – Senior Seminar: Home Equity and Healthcare, Presented by Change
  Home Mortgage, 10:30AM.
  •  Thursday, November 6th – Excursion: Valley View Casino, 8:30AM-4:00PM.
  •  Sunday, November 9th – Senior Dinner Dance, Autumn Nights and City Lights, 4:00PM-7:00PM.
  •  Monday, November 10th – Movie Matinee: Because I Said So, 12:30PM.
  •  Saturday, November 15th – Senior Craft Fair, 9:00AM-1:00PM.
  •  Tuesday, November 18th – Excursion: Living Desert Zoo and Gardens Safari Tour, 8:00AM-6:00PM.
  •  Thursday, November 20th – Senior Thanksgiving Luncheon, 10:00AM.
  •  Monday, October 13th – Movie Matinee: Coco, 12:30PM.
  •  Monday, November 24th – Friday, November 28th – Thanksgiving Holiday Closure.

  Public Comments: Scott announced the Senior Craft Fair at Hillcrest was a
  success. They received $8.000.00 from the event. Yvonne announced that the
  Veteran’s Officer is on leave for the time being and a replacement officer has
  been assigned to the Community Center.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 11:00AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, November 19, 2025 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Parks & Recreation Specialist
